title: 2.3 Common Objects
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize and name six high-frequency portable or classroom objects.
grammar_function: A noun; It is a noun; negative contrast (It is a... not a...).
prerequisite: 2.1-2.2 non-person identity frame and Unit 1 not negation.
speaking_outcome: Produce six short object identity sentences after a model.

cards.prompt: It is a book, not a bus.
cards.audio_text: It is a book, not a bus.
cards.spanish_translation: Es un libro, no un autobús.
cards.pedagogy_note: Repetition with growth: contrast object with vehicle via negation
